That resolves it. Pay the $371.48 deposit using the personal card already attached to the extension, and leave the remaining balance for checkout.

The $371.48 personal deposit has been paid, and the extension is confirmed. The remaining $371.47 is due at checkout Sunday. Keep the updated extension confirmation and the hotel’s written billing note; on Friday morning, obtain the employer folio, refresh both keys, and verify that the active payment method is the personal card before any new charges are posted.
